about_the_game:
Get psyched!

The world’s funkiest FPS is finally coming to Steam!

Open Fortress is a fully custom mod that builds on Team Fortress 2’s world-famous gunplay to create a smooth, stylish experience inspired by old-school FPS games. The Open Fortress experience is lovingly hand-crafted to ensure the best possible vibes, remaining true to the essence of TF2’s mid-century aesthetic while taking earnest inspiration from seventies action flicks. Featuring all new maps, all new guns, and an original soundtrack inspired by the funky tunes of the era.

Set several years after the Gravel War, Open Fortress envisions a new age in the Team Fortress universe. In the futuristic world of 1979, the heart of mercenary gunfighting has shifted from covert war in the Badlands of New Mexico to a worldwide free-for-all! Battle it out on a level playing field to seize weapons, power-ups, and a place on the podium from your foes!

Meet the Mercenary!

Play as the Mercenary: expert wisecracker, professional action hero, and master of every weapon known to Merc-kind. No need for class selection, because he’s always classy, and always the man for the job. Master the Merc’s incredible potential to gain the upper hand on your strangely handsome rivals!

Dress to kill!

Help Merc make his mark on the battlefield! Choose from dozens of cosmetic options to be the most stylish Mercenary around, and outdress your foes while you outplay them. Customize your outfit using newfangled technology unique to Open Fortress: an ‘adjustable color slider’! The best part? It’s all free!

Solve problems with violence!

Master an all-new arsenal of fancy weapons and familiar power-ups to triumph in varied game modes! Steal briefcases, capture flags, and murder mercenaries en masse! Seize the best tool for the situation, and switch strategies on the fly to outplay your opponents! Kill people with dynamite, chainsaws, and really big guns!

See the world! Meet new people! Frag them!

Take the fight worldwide (and beyond)! Battle across dozens of original maps designed especially for Open Fortress, inspired by the best levels ever to grace the boomer shooter scene. Visit all-new locations ranging from the Merc’s home of Sestero, NY to outer space! Have high-speed shootouts everywhere from skate parks to still-operational oil rigs! Zip around really fast and murder people!

content_descriptors.notes: Open Fortress contains cartoon-style depictions of blood, violence, dismemberment, and gore during gameplay; use of crude, strong language for comedic effect; and brief appearances of smoking and alcohol (not that we endorse either). Users may interact through online matches operated by community members. There are no in-game purchases or microtransactions.

name: Open Fortress

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 21H2 or later
  • Processor: Quad-Core 2.5GHz Processor or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 400 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 8.1
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Additional disk space may be required since Open Fortress requires Team Fortress 2 to be installed.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 21H2 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 (Quad-Core ~3.0 GHz or better)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 950 or better
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

short_description: Open Fortress is a mod for Team Fortress 2 that envisions a new wave of mercenary gunfighting. Bunny hop through original maps set in the futuristic world of the 1970s, and blast your way to victory with an all-new arsenal of groovy weapons! Frequently updated with new maps, modes, and mayhem!
